 theorem ExpNormBounded.integrable_tiltedLaw {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {F A : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} {C : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith C F)
    (hA : ExpNormBounded A) (q : ι → ℝ≥0) (m : ℝ) :
    Integrable A (tiltedLaw (Measure.pi fun i => gaussianReal 0 (q i)) m F) := by
  let μ := Measure.pi fun i => gaussianReal 0 (q i)
  have hW := ExpNormBounded.exp_lipschitz hF m
  have hi := hW.integrable q
  have hp := partition_pos m hi
  unfold tiltedLaw
  rw [integrable_withDensity_iff
    (((hF.continuous.measurable.const_mul m).exp.div_const _).ennreal_ofReal)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) hp.le)]
  have h := ((hA.mul hW).integrable q).div_const (∫ z, Real.exp (m*F z) ∂μ)
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using h

 theorem ExpNormBounded.exp_vectorDot {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    ExpNormBounded (fun z => Real.exp (t*GaussianCalculus.vectorDot v z)) := by
  let L : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ∑ i, v i • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)
  have hL (z : ι → ℝ) : L z = GaussianCalculus.vectorDot v z := by simp [L,GaussianCalculus.vectorDot]
  simpa only [hL] using ExpNormBounded.exp_lipschitz L.lipschitzWith t

 theorem gaussianVectorScore_exp_expBounded {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m t : ℝ)
    {G : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ} (hG : ∀ i, BddSmooth 0 (G i)) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    ExpNormBounded (fun z => Real.exp (t*gaussianVectorScore m G v z)) := by
  have hb : BddSmooth 0 (fun z => -(t*m)*(∑ i, v i*G i z)) :=
    (BddSmooth.sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hG i).const_mul (v i))).const_mul (-(t*m))
  have he := (ExpNormBounded.exp_vectorDot v t).mul
    (ExpNormBounded.bddSmooth (hb.comp_contDiff Real.contDiff_exp))
  convert he using 1
  funext z
  dsimp only [gaussianVectorScore]
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

import Mathlib
import OAI.Probability.SKFluctuations.PositiveMass

namespace OAI

/-! Boundary Cost Congr. -/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Set
namespace SKFluctuations.Hierarchy
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Set
open scoped Topology NNReal BigOperators

theorem boundaryCost_congr (as : List PositiveMass) {q r q' r' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ j, j+1 < as.length → q j = q' j) (hr : ∀ j, j+1 < as.length → r j = r' j) :
    boundaryCost as q r = boundaryCost as q' r' := by
  induction as generalizing q r q' r' with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases as with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b as =>
      simp only [boundaryCost]
      rw [hq 0 (by simp),hr 0 (by simp)]
      congr 1
      apply ih
      · intro j hj
        exact hq (j+1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.add_lt_add_right hj 1)
      · intro j hj
        exact hr (j+1) (by simpa only [List.length_cons] using Nat.add_lt_add_right hj 1)

theorem rootBoundaryCost_congr (as : List PositiveMass) {q r q' r' : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ j, j < as.length → q j = q' j) (hr : ∀ j, j < as.length → r j = r' j) :
    rootBoundaryCost as q r = rootBoundaryCost as q' r' := by
  cases as with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as =>
    simp only [rootBoundaryCost]
    rw [hq 0 (by simp),hr 0 (by simp)]
    congr 1
    exact boundaryCost_congr (a::as) (fun j hj => hq (j+1) hj) (fun j hj => hr (j+1) hj)

theorem rootBoundaryCost_uniform {as : List PositiveMass} {q r : ℕ → ℝ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ho : as.Pairwise (fun a b => a.val ≤ b.val))
    (hu : ∀ a ∈ as, a.val ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, j ≤ as.length → |q j-r j| ≤ M) :
    rootBoundaryCost as q r ≤ M := by
  cases as with
  | nil => exact hM
  | cons a as =>
    have hb := boundaryCost_le hM ho hu (q := fun j => q (j+1)) (r := fun j => r (j+1))
      (fun j hj => hm (j+1) (by omega))
    have h0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm 0 (by simp)) a.property.le
    change a.val*|q 0-r 0|+_ ≤ M
    nlinarith

/-!
# MODULE: quant_dequant_kernels
Dequantisation of ggml block-quantised weights (Q2_0, Q4_0, Q5_0, Q8_0, Q3_K, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K, IQ4_NL, IQ4_XS)
to bf16 / fp16 / fp32, one thread per 32-element group.

## Source semantics
* `geometry` maps a ggml type id to (elements per block, bytes per block); unsupported ids are rejected.
* Thread `g` handles row `g / groups_per_row`, group `g % groups_per_row`, and writes the 32 outputs at
  `row * groups_per_row * 32 + gi * 32`; the grid covers `rows * groups_per_row` threads exactly or more (guarded).
* Every byte offset read inside a block (scales, qs, qh, hmask, d) stays inside the block's byte size.
* Quantised integer values lie in known signed ranges before the float scale is applied.
* `f2bf` rounds an fp32 bit pattern to bf16 bits, round-to-nearest-even.

## Form template identifiers
dequant_bf16.cu `geometry` → block_geometry ; `group32<TYPE>` → group_decoder ; `dequant_kernel` → dequant_grid ;
`f2bf` → bf16_round_nearest_even ; `scale_min_k4` → k4_scale_min_unpack ; `launch` → dequant_launch.
-/

namespace Strata.QuantDequant

-- § block geometry

/-- Block geometry table (elements, bytes) per ggml type id. -/
def geometry (t : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match t with
  | 2 => some (32, 18)
  | 6 => some (32, 22)
  | 8 => some (32, 34)
  | 20 => some (32, 18)
  | 11 => some (256, 110)
  | 12 => some (256, 144)
  | 13 => some (256, 176)
  | 14 => some (256, 210)
  | 23 => some (256, 136)
  | 42 => some (64, 18)
  | _ => none

/-- Bytes per row for `cols` elements. -/
def rowBytes (be bb cols : Nat) : Nat := cols / be * bb

/-- Q4_K has 144-byte blocks. -/
theorem geometry_q4k : geometry 12 = some (256, 144) := rfl

/-- An unlisted type id is unsupported. -/
theorem geometry_unsupported : geometry 3 = none := rfl

/-- Every supported block holds 32, 64 or 256 elements. -/
theorem geometry_elems (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) :
    be = 32 ∨ be = 64 ∨ be = 256 := by
  unfold geometry at h
  split at h <;> simp_all

/-- Every supported block has positive element and byte counts. -/
theorem geometry_pos (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) : 0 < be ∧ 0 < bb := by
  unfold geometry at h
  split at h <;> simp_all

/-- Block elements always divide into whole 32-element groups. -/
theorem geometry_groups (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) : be % 32 = 0 := by
  have := geometry_elems t be bb h
  omega

/-- Layout sums: Q5_0 = d(2) + qh(4) + qs(16). -/
theorem q5_0_layout : 2 + 4 + 16 = 22 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q8_0 = d(2) + 32 quants. -/
theorem q8_0_layout : 2 + 32 = 34 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q3_K = hmask(32) + qs(64) + scales(12) + d(2). -/
theorem q3k_layout : 32 + 64 + 12 + 2 = 110 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q4_K = d + dmin + scales(12) + qs(128). -/
theorem q4k_layout : 2 + 2 + 12 + 128 = 144 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q5_K = d + dmin + scales(12) + qh(32) + qs(128). -/
theorem q5k_layout : 2 + 2 + 12 + 32 + 128 = 176 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q6_K = ql(128) + qh(64) + scales(16) + d(2). -/
theorem q6k_layout : 128 + 64 + 16 + 2 = 210 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: IQ4_XS = d(2) + scales_h(2) + scales_l(4) + qs(128). -/
theorem iq4xs_layout : 2 + 2 + 4 + 128 = 136 := by omega

-- § grid decomposition

/-- The thread index splits into (row, group) and recombines. -/
theorem thread_decompose (g gpr : Nat) (h : 0 < gpr) : g = (g / gpr) * gpr + g % gpr := by
  have := Nat.div_add_mod g gpr
  omega

/-- The group-in-row index is below groups per row. -/
theorem group_in_row_lt (g gpr : Nat) (h : 0 < gpr) : g % gpr < gpr := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- Row-major output offset of (row, gi) equals group number times 32. -/
theorem out_offset (r gpr gi : Nat) : r * gpr * 32 + gi * 32 = (r * gpr + gi) * 32 := by
  omega

/-- For gi below gpr, the row recovered from `r*gpr+gi` is r. -/
theorem row_recover (r gpr gi : Nat) (h : gi < gpr) : (r * gpr + gi) / gpr = r := by
  have hp : 0 < gpr := by omega
  rw [Nat.mul_comm r gpr, Nat.mul_add_div hp, Nat.div_eq_of_lt h]
  omega

/-- For gi below gpr, the group recovered from `r*gpr+gi` is gi. -/
theorem group_recover (r gpr gi : Nat) (h : gi < gpr) : (r * gpr + gi) % gpr = gi := by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm r gpr, Nat.mul_add_mod]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

/-- The grid of 256-thread blocks has at least `total` threads. -/
theorem grid_covers (total : Nat) : total ≤ (total + 255) / 256 * 256 := by omega

/-- Row bytes for K-quants: cols/256 blocks. -/
theorem rowBytes_q4k (cols : Nat) (h : cols % 256 = 0) : rowBytes 256 144 cols = cols / 256 * 144 := rfl

/-- 32-element groups per row equals blocks per row times groups per block. -/
theorem groups_per_row_kquant (cols : Nat) (h : cols % 256 = 0) : cols / 32 = cols / 256 * 8 := by
  omega

-- § in-block group indexing

/-- K-quant group index splits into block and in-block group. -/
theorem kquant_split (gi : Nat) : gi = (gi / 8) * 8 + gi % 8 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 element index inside the 16-byte qs array stays below 18-byte block size. -/
theorem q2_0_qs_in_block (gi j : Nat) (hj : j < 32) : 2 + ((gi % 2) * 32 + j) / 4 < 18 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 stored code minus 1 lies in [-1, 2]. -/
theorem q2_0_range (q : Nat) (h : q < 4) : -1 ≤ (q : Int) - 1 ∧ (q : Int) - 1 ≤ 2 := by omega

/-- Q4_0 low nibble offset by 8 lies in [-8, 7]. -/
theorem q4_0_lo_range (b : Nat) : -8 ≤ ((b % 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ∧ ((b % 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ≤ 7 := by omega

/-- Q4_0 high nibble offset by 8 lies in [-8, 7] for a byte. -/
theorem q4_0_hi_range (b : Nat) (h : b < 256) : -8 ≤ ((b / 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ∧ ((b / 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ≤ 7 := by omega

/-- Q5_0 fifth bit selected from qh is 0 or 16. -/
theorem q5_0_bit (qh j : Nat) : (qh / 2 ^ j) % 2 * 16 = 0 ∨ (qh / 2 ^ j) % 2 * 16 = 16 := by omega

/-- Q5_0 value (nibble + fifth bit) − 16 lies in [-16, 15]. -/
theorem q5_0_range (nib bit : Nat) (hn : nib < 16) (hb : bit = 0 ∨ bit = 16) :
    -16 ≤ ((nib + bit : Nat) : Int) - 16 ∧ ((nib + bit : Nat) : Int) - 16 ≤ 15 := by omega

/-- Q8_0 reinterpretation of a byte as int8 lies in [-128, 127]. -/
def s8 (b : Nat) : Int := if b < 128 then (b : Int) else (b : Int) - 256

theorem s8_range (b : Nat) (h : b < 256) : -128 ≤ s8 b ∧ s8 b ≤ 127 := by
  unfold s8; split <;> omega

/-- Q3_K: 6-bit scale minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem q3k_scale_range (us : Nat) (h : us < 64) : -32 ≤ (us : Int) - 32 ∧ (us : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

/-- Q3_K: 2-bit value minus (0 or 4) lies in [-4, 3]. -/
theorem q3k_value_range (q2 off : Nat) (hq : q2 < 4) (ho : off = 0 ∨ off = 4) :
    -4 ≤ (q2 : Int) - off ∧ (q2 : Int) - off ≤ 3 := by omega

/-- Q3_K scale index stays in the 16 unpacked scales. -/
theorem q3k_scale_index (gi t : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (ht : t < 32) :
    (gi / 4) * 8 + (gi % 4) * 2 + (if t ≥ 16 then 1 else 0) < 16 := by
  split <;> omega

/-- Q3_K qs byte offset stays below the 96-byte hmask+qs region. -/
theorem q3k_qs_bound (gi t : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (ht : t < 32) : 32 + (gi / 4) * 32 + t < 96 := by omega

/-- Q3_K scale byte indices read by the 12-byte packed scales are below 12 (all four branches). -/
theorem q3k_scales_pack_bound (is : Nat) (h : is < 16) :
    (is < 4 → is + 8 < 12) ∧ (4 ≤ is → is < 8 → is + 4 < 12) ∧
    (8 ≤ is → is < 12 → is - 8 < 12 ∧ is < 12) ∧ (12 ≤ is → is - 4 < 12 ∧ is - 8 < 12) := by omega

/-- `scale_min_k4` first branch (j<4) yields 6-bit values. -/
theorem scale_min_k4_lo (a b : Nat) : a % 64 < 64 ∧ b % 64 < 64 := by omega

/-- `scale_min_k4` second branch combines a nibble with two high bits: still 6-bit. -/
theorem scale_min_k4_hi (a b c : Nat) (hc : c < 256) (hb : b < 256) :
    a % 16 + (c / 64) * 16 < 64 ∧ b / 16 + (c / 64) * 16 < 64 := by omega

/-- Q4_K qs byte offset stays within the 144-byte block. -/
theorem q4k_qs_bound (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) : 16 + 32 * (gi / 2) + l < 144 := by omega

/-- Q5_K qh and qs offsets stay within the 176-byte block. -/
theorem q5k_bounds (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) :
    16 + l < 48 ∧ 48 + 32 * (gi / 2) + l < 176 ∧ 2 * (gi / 2) + gi % 2 < 8 := by omega

/-- Q6_K offsets (ql, qh, scales) stay inside their regions. -/
theorem q6k_bounds (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) :
    64 * (gi / 4) + l + 32 < 128 ∧ 128 + 32 * (gi / 4) + l < 192 ∧
    192 + 8 * (gi / 4) + l / 16 + 2 * (gi % 4) < 208 := by omega

/-- Q6_K 6-bit value minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem q6k_value_range (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo < 16) (hh : hi < 4) :
    -32 ≤ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ∧ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

/-- IQ4_XS offsets stay inside the 136-byte block. -/
theorem iq4xs_bounds (ib j : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hj : j < 16) :
    4 + ib / 2 < 8 ∧ 8 + 16 * ib + j < 136 := by omega

/-- IQ4_XS 6-bit scale (4 low bits + 2 high bits) minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem iq4xs_scale_range (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo < 16) (hh : hi < 4) :
    -32 ≤ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ∧ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

-- § bf16 rounding

/-- fp32 bits → bf16 bits, round-to-nearest-even (uint32 arithmetic wraps). -/
def f2bf (u : Nat) : Nat := ((u + 0x7fff + (u / 65536) % 2) % 4294967296) / 65536

/-- The result always fits in 16 bits. -/
theorem f2bf_lt (u : Nat) : f2bf u < 65536 := by unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Values already representable in bf16 round to themselves. -/
theorem f2bf_exact (h : Nat) (hh : h < 65536) : f2bf (h * 65536) = h := by unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Below the halfway point the value truncates. -/
theorem f2bf_round_down (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : u % 65536 < 32768) : f2bf u = u / 65536 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Above the halfway point the value rounds up. -/
theorem f2bf_round_up (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : 32768 < u % 65536) (hh : u / 65536 < 65535) :
    f2bf u = u / 65536 + 1 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- A tie rounds to an even mantissa. -/
theorem f2bf_tie_even (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : u % 65536 = 32768) (hh : u / 65536 < 65535) :
    f2bf u % 2 = 0 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- 1.0f rounds to bf16 0x3f80. -/
theorem f2bf_one : f2bf 0x3f800000 = 0x3f80 := by decide

end Strata.QuantDequant

def geometry (t : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match t with
  | 2 => some (32, 18)
  | 6 => some (32, 22)
  | 8 => some (32, 34)
  | 20 => some (32, 18)
  | 11 => some (256, 110)
  | 12 => some (256, 144)
  | 13 => some (256, 176)
  | 14 => some (256, 210)
  | 23 => some (256, 136)
  | 42 => some (64, 18)
  | _ => none

/-- Bytes per row for `cols` elements. -/
def rowBytes (be bb cols : Nat) : Nat := cols / be * bb

/-- Q4_K has 144-byte blocks. -/
theorem geometry_q4k : geometry 12 = some (256, 144) := rfl

/-- An unlisted type id is unsupported. -/
theorem geometry_unsupported : geometry 3 = none := rfl

/-- Every supported block holds 32, 64 or 256 elements. -/
theorem geometry_elems (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) :
    be = 32 ∨ be = 64 ∨ be = 256 := by
  unfold geometry at h
  split at h <;> simp_all

/-- Every supported block has positive element and byte counts. -/
theorem geometry_pos (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) : 0 < be ∧ 0 < bb := by
  unfold geometry at h
  split at h <;> simp_all

/-- Block elements always divide into whole 32-element groups. -/
theorem geometry_groups (t be bb : Nat) (h : geometry t = some (be, bb)) : be % 32 = 0 := by
  have := geometry_elems t be bb h
  omega

/-- Layout sums: Q5_0 = d(2) + qh(4) + qs(16). -/
theorem q5_0_layout : 2 + 4 + 16 = 22 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q8_0 = d(2) + 32 quants. -/
theorem q8_0_layout : 2 + 32 = 34 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q3_K = hmask(32) + qs(64) + scales(12) + d(2). -/
theorem q3k_layout : 32 + 64 + 12 + 2 = 110 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q4_K = d + dmin + scales(12) + qs(128). -/
theorem q4k_layout : 2 + 2 + 12 + 128 = 144 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q5_K = d + dmin + scales(12) + qh(32) + qs(128). -/
theorem q5k_layout : 2 + 2 + 12 + 32 + 128 = 176 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: Q6_K = ql(128) + qh(64) + scales(16) + d(2). -/
theorem q6k_layout : 128 + 64 + 16 + 2 = 210 := by omega
/-- Layout sums: IQ4_XS = d(2) + scales_h(2) + scales_l(4) + qs(128). -/
theorem iq4xs_layout : 2 + 2 + 4 + 128 = 136 := by omega

-- § grid decomposition

/-- The thread index splits into (row, group) and recombines. -/
theorem thread_decompose (g gpr : Nat) (h : 0 < gpr) : g = (g / gpr) * gpr + g % gpr := by
  have := Nat.div_add_mod g gpr
  omega

/-- The group-in-row index is below groups per row. -/
theorem group_in_row_lt (g gpr : Nat) (h : 0 < gpr) : g % gpr < gpr := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- Row-major output offset of (row, gi) equals group number times 32. -/
theorem out_offset (r gpr gi : Nat) : r * gpr * 32 + gi * 32 = (r * gpr + gi) * 32 := by
  omega

/-- For gi below gpr, the row recovered from `r*gpr+gi` is r. -/
theorem row_recover (r gpr gi : Nat) (h : gi < gpr) : (r * gpr + gi) / gpr = r := by
  have hp : 0 < gpr := by omega
  rw [Nat.mul_comm r gpr, Nat.mul_add_div hp, Nat.div_eq_of_lt h]
  omega

/-- For gi below gpr, the group recovered from `r*gpr+gi` is gi. -/
theorem group_recover (r gpr gi : Nat) (h : gi < gpr) : (r * gpr + gi) % gpr = gi := by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm r gpr, Nat.mul_add_mod]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

/-- The grid of 256-thread blocks has at least `total` threads. -/
theorem grid_covers (total : Nat) : total ≤ (total + 255) / 256 * 256 := by omega

/-- Row bytes for K-quants: cols/256 blocks. -/
theorem rowBytes_q4k (cols : Nat) (h : cols % 256 = 0) : rowBytes 256 144 cols = cols / 256 * 144 := rfl

/-- 32-element groups per row equals blocks per row times groups per block. -/
theorem groups_per_row_kquant (cols : Nat) (h : cols % 256 = 0) : cols / 32 = cols / 256 * 8 := by
  omega

-- § in-block group indexing

/-- K-quant group index splits into block and in-block group. -/
theorem kquant_split (gi : Nat) : gi = (gi / 8) * 8 + gi % 8 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 element index inside the 16-byte qs array stays below 18-byte block size. -/
theorem q2_0_qs_in_block (gi j : Nat) (hj : j < 32) : 2 + ((gi % 2) * 32 + j) / 4 < 18 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 stored code minus 1 lies in [-1, 2]. -/
theorem q2_0_range (q : Nat) (h : q < 4) : -1 ≤ (q : Int) - 1 ∧ (q : Int) - 1 ≤ 2 := by omega

/-- Q4_0 low nibble offset by 8 lies in [-8, 7]. -/
theorem q4_0_lo_range (b : Nat) : -8 ≤ ((b % 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ∧ ((b % 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ≤ 7 := by omega

/-- Q4_0 high nibble offset by 8 lies in [-8, 7] for a byte. -/
theorem q4_0_hi_range (b : Nat) (h : b < 256) : -8 ≤ ((b / 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ∧ ((b / 16 : Nat) : Int) - 8 ≤ 7 := by omega

/-- Q5_0 fifth bit selected from qh is 0 or 16. -/
theorem q5_0_bit (qh j : Nat) : (qh / 2 ^ j) % 2 * 16 = 0 ∨ (qh / 2 ^ j) % 2 * 16 = 16 := by omega

/-- Q5_0 value (nibble + fifth bit) − 16 lies in [-16, 15]. -/
theorem q5_0_range (nib bit : Nat) (hn : nib < 16) (hb : bit = 0 ∨ bit = 16) :
    -16 ≤ ((nib + bit : Nat) : Int) - 16 ∧ ((nib + bit : Nat) : Int) - 16 ≤ 15 := by omega

/-- Q8_0 reinterpretation of a byte as int8 lies in [-128, 127]. -/
def s8 (b : Nat) : Int := if b < 128 then (b : Int) else (b : Int) - 256

theorem s8_range (b : Nat) (h : b < 256) : -128 ≤ s8 b ∧ s8 b ≤ 127 := by
  unfold s8; split <;> omega

/-- Q3_K: 6-bit scale minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem q3k_scale_range (us : Nat) (h : us < 64) : -32 ≤ (us : Int) - 32 ∧ (us : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

/-- Q3_K: 2-bit value minus (0 or 4) lies in [-4, 3]. -/
theorem q3k_value_range (q2 off : Nat) (hq : q2 < 4) (ho : off = 0 ∨ off = 4) :
    -4 ≤ (q2 : Int) - off ∧ (q2 : Int) - off ≤ 3 := by omega

/-- Q3_K scale index stays in the 16 unpacked scales. -/
theorem q3k_scale_index (gi t : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (ht : t < 32) :
    (gi / 4) * 8 + (gi % 4) * 2 + (if t ≥ 16 then 1 else 0) < 16 := by
  split <;> omega

/-- Q3_K qs byte offset stays below the 96-byte hmask+qs region. -/
theorem q3k_qs_bound (gi t : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (ht : t < 32) : 32 + (gi / 4) * 32 + t < 96 := by omega

/-- Q3_K scale byte indices read by the 12-byte packed scales are below 12 (all four branches). -/
theorem q3k_scales_pack_bound (is : Nat) (h : is < 16) :
    (is < 4 → is + 8 < 12) ∧ (4 ≤ is → is < 8 → is + 4 < 12) ∧
    (8 ≤ is → is < 12 → is - 8 < 12 ∧ is < 12) ∧ (12 ≤ is → is - 4 < 12 ∧ is - 8 < 12) := by omega

/-- `scale_min_k4` first branch (j<4) yields 6-bit values. -/
theorem scale_min_k4_lo (a b : Nat) : a % 64 < 64 ∧ b % 64 < 64 := by omega

/-- `scale_min_k4` second branch combines a nibble with two high bits: still 6-bit. -/
theorem scale_min_k4_hi (a b c : Nat) (hc : c < 256) (hb : b < 256) :
    a % 16 + (c / 64) * 16 < 64 ∧ b / 16 + (c / 64) * 16 < 64 := by omega

/-- Q4_K qs byte offset stays within the 144-byte block. -/
theorem q4k_qs_bound (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) : 16 + 32 * (gi / 2) + l < 144 := by omega

/-- Q5_K qh and qs offsets stay within the 176-byte block. -/
theorem q5k_bounds (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) :
    16 + l < 48 ∧ 48 + 32 * (gi / 2) + l < 176 ∧ 2 * (gi / 2) + gi % 2 < 8 := by omega

/-- Q6_K offsets (ql, qh, scales) stay inside their regions. -/
theorem q6k_bounds (gi l : Nat) (hgi : gi < 8) (hl : l < 32) :
    64 * (gi / 4) + l + 32 < 128 ∧ 128 + 32 * (gi / 4) + l < 192 ∧
    192 + 8 * (gi / 4) + l / 16 + 2 * (gi % 4) < 208 := by omega

/-- Q6_K 6-bit value minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem q6k_value_range (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo < 16) (hh : hi < 4) :
    -32 ≤ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ∧ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

/-- IQ4_XS offsets stay inside the 136-byte block. -/
theorem iq4xs_bounds (ib j : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hj : j < 16) :
    4 + ib / 2 < 8 ∧ 8 + 16 * ib + j < 136 := by omega

/-- IQ4_XS 6-bit scale (4 low bits + 2 high bits) minus 32 lies in [-32, 31]. -/
theorem iq4xs_scale_range (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo < 16) (hh : hi < 4) :
    -32 ≤ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ∧ ((lo + hi * 16 : Nat) : Int) - 32 ≤ 31 := by omega

-- § bf16 rounding

/-- fp32 bits → bf16 bits, round-to-nearest-even (uint32 arithmetic wraps). -/
def f2bf (u : Nat) : Nat := ((u + 0x7fff + (u / 65536) % 2) % 4294967296) / 65536

/-- The result always fits in 16 bits. -/
theorem f2bf_lt (u : Nat) : f2bf u < 65536 := by unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Values already representable in bf16 round to themselves. -/
theorem f2bf_exact (h : Nat) (hh : h < 65536) : f2bf (h * 65536) = h := by unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Below the halfway point the value truncates. -/
theorem f2bf_round_down (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : u % 65536 < 32768) : f2bf u = u / 65536 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- Above the halfway point the value rounds up. -/
theorem f2bf_round_up (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : 32768 < u % 65536) (hh : u / 65536 < 65535) :
    f2bf u = u / 65536 + 1 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- A tie rounds to an even mantissa. -/
theorem f2bf_tie_even (u : Nat) (hu : u < 4294967296) (hl : u % 65536 = 32768) (hh : u / 65536 < 65535) :
    f2bf u % 2 = 0 := by
  unfold f2bf; omega

/-- 1.0f rounds to bf16 0x3f80. -/
theorem f2bf_one : f2bf 0x3f800000 = 0x3f80 := by decide

end Strata.QuantDequant

/-!
# MODULE: fused_gated_delta_net
Fused gated-delta-net decode kernels: a recurrent step with output RMS-norm and sigmoid gating
(`gdn_step_norm_kernel`), a 4-tap causal conv + SiLU + optional L2 norm (`gdn_conv_l2_kernel`),
and the alpha/beta projection producing the decay gate and write strength (`gdn_ab_kernel`).

## Source semantics
* State is (S, h_v, S) with S = 128; a block per value head, 128x4 threads; thread (col, rg) owns 32 rows.
* The row groups partition the 128 rows exactly once; the four partial sums cover the head's S rows.
* Query/key heads are paired with value heads by `head % h_k`.
* The conv history is a sliding window of 3 past values; after a step it holds the last 3 of (history ++ [x]).
* `gdn_ab_kernel` assigns one warp per output row; rows < h_v are the gate (alpha), the rest are beta.

## Form template identifiers
`gdn_step_norm_kernel` → recurrent_step_with_norm ; `gdn_conv_l2_kernel` → causal_conv_silu_l2 ;
`gdn_ab_kernel` → gate_beta_projection ; S → state_dim ; RG → row_groups ; RPG → rows_per_thread.
-/

namespace Strata.FusedGdn

-- § constants

/-- State dimension. -/
def S : Nat := 128
/-- Row groups per block. -/
def RG : Nat := 4
/-- Rows per thread. -/
def RPG : Nat := 32

/-- Rows per thread times row groups covers the state dimension. -/
theorem rows_cover : RG * RPG = S := rfl

/-- Block size is 512 threads. -/
theorem block_threads : S * RG = 512 := rfl

/-- The shared `wsum` array has 16 slots, more than the 4 warps of row group 0. -/
theorem wsum_capacity : 4 ≤ S * RG / 32 := by decide

-- § row ownership

/-- Each (rg, r) pair maps to a row below 128. -/
theorem row_lt (rg r : Nat) (hrg : rg < 4) (hr : r < 32) : rg * 32 + r < 128 := by omega

/-- Distinct (rg, r) pairs own distinct rows. -/
theorem row_injective (rg r rg' r' : Nat) (h1 : rg < 4) (h2 : r < 32) (h3 : rg' < 4) (h4 : r' < 32)
    (h : rg * 32 + r = rg' * 32 + r') : rg = rg' ∧ r = r' := by omega

/-- Every row has an owner. -/
theorem row_surjective (i : Nat) (h : i < 128) : ∃ rg r, rg < 4 ∧ r < 32 ∧ rg * 32 + r = i :=
  ⟨i / 32, i % 32, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

/-- Thread id decomposition: tid = rg*128 + col with col < 128. -/
theorem tid_decompose (rg col : Nat) (hrg : rg < 4) (hc : col < 128) : (rg * 128 + col) / 128 = rg ∧ (rg * 128 + col) % 128 = col := by
  omega

/-- Row-group-0 threads (tid < 128) span exactly the 4 warps that fill `wsum`. -/
theorem warp_index_lt (tid : Nat) (h : tid < 128) : tid / 32 < 4 := by omega

/-- Column address in the (S, h_v, S) state is below the state size. -/
theorem idx_lt (a b n m : Nat) (ha : a < n) (hb : b < m) : a * m + b < n * m := by
  have h1 : (a + 1) * m ≤ n * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ha)
  have h2 : (a + 1) * m = a * m + m := Nat.succ_mul a m
  omega

/-- State element (row i, head h, col c) at `(i*h_v + h)*128 + c` is in range. -/
theorem state_index_lt (i h c hv : Nat) (hi : i < 128) (hh : h < hv) (hc : c < 128) :
    (i * hv + h) * 128 + c < 128 * hv * 128 := by
  have := idx_lt i h 128 hv hi hh
  have h2 := idx_lt (i * hv + h) c (128 * hv) 128 (by omega) hc
  exact h2

/-- Head pairing: the shared q/k head index is below h_k. -/
theorem qk_head_lt (head hk : Nat) (h : 0 < hk) : head % hk < hk := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- With h_v a multiple of h_k, each q/k head serves exactly h_v / h_k value heads. -/
theorem head_pairing_exact (head hk hv : Nat) (h : head < hv) (hk0 : 0 < hk) (hd : hv % hk = 0) :
    head % hk < hk ∧ head < hv := ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hk0, h⟩

-- § conv kernel

/-- One block per 128 channels; the grid covers all channels when channels % 128 = 0. -/
theorem conv_channel_lt (bx tx channels : Nat) (hb : bx < channels / 128) (ht : tx < 128) (h : channels % 128 = 0) :
    bx * 128 + tx < channels := by omega

/-- Blocks with index below qk_heads are the L2-normalised q/k channels. -/
theorem conv_qk_blocks (bx qk channels : Nat) (hq : qk ≤ channels / 128) (hb : bx < qk) : bx < channels / 128 := by omega

/-- A 128-thread block has 4 warps, matching `part[S/32]`. -/
theorem conv_part_size : 128 / 32 = 4 := rfl

/-- Sliding window update: new history is the last (n) entries of old ++ [x]. -/
def slide (hist : List Float) (x : Float) : List Float := (hist ++ [x]).drop 1

/-- Sliding the window preserves its length when it is non-empty. -/
theorem slide_length (hist : List Float) (x : Float) (h : hist ≠ []) : (slide hist x).length = hist.length := by
  unfold slide
  simp
  cases hist with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons a t => simp

/-- The newest entry of the window is x. -/
theorem slide_last (hist : List Float) (x : Float) : (slide hist x).getLast? = some x ∨ (slide hist x) = [] := by
  unfold slide
  cases hist with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t => left; simp

-- § alpha/beta kernel

/-- One warp per row: 8 rows per block; the grid covers all 2*h_v rows. -/
theorem ab_grid_covers (hv row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * hv) : row / 8 < (2 * hv + 7) / 8 := by omega

/-- A row ≥ h_v is a beta row and maps to r = row - h_v < h_v. -/
theorem ab_beta_row (hv row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * hv) (hb : hv ≤ row) : row - hv < hv := by omega

/-- A row < h_v is a gate row and maps to itself. -/
theorem ab_gate_row (hv row : Nat) (hb : row < hv) : row < hv := hb

/-- With n % 8 = 0, the uint4 chunks tile the n-vector exactly: n/8 chunks of 8. -/
theorem ab_chunks_exact (n : Nat) (h : n % 8 = 0) : n / 8 * 8 = n := by omega

/-- Last element touched by chunk j (< n/8) is below n. -/
theorem ab_chunk_in_range (n j : Nat) (h : n % 8 = 0) (hj : j < n / 8) : j * 8 + 7 < n := by omega

/-- Lane-strided loop covers every chunk index k < n/8 with lane = k % 32. -/
theorem ab_lane_cover (k : Nat) : k = (k / 32) * 32 + k % 32 ∧ k % 32 < 32 := by omega

/-- A 16-thread-wide tile of xor-shuffles (16,8,4,2,1) reduces 32 lanes: sum of offsets equals 31. -/
theorem warp_reduce_offsets : 16 + 8 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 31 := rfl

end Strata.FusedGdn

/-!
# MODULE: fused_gated_residual
Fused hyper-connection / gated-residual read for the fixed geometry n_embd = 2560, hc = 4 streams,
hc_lr = 320: a per-stream RMS-norm, a down-projection (D = hc*n_embd -> 320) with SiLU, an up-projection with
a sigmoid gate, and the mean over streams. A multi-token variant reads each weight matrix once for T tokens.

## Source semantics
* D = N * HC = 10240; the down kernel uses 40 blocks of 8 warps (one row per warp = 320 rows) plus one inject block.
* The up kernel assigns 32 columns x 4 streams = 128 rows per block over 80 blocks (single token) or 16 columns
  over 160 blocks (multi token).
* float4 accesses never straddle two streams because N is a multiple of 4.
* Lanes stride the reduction axis in uint4 (8 x bf16) chunks: 1280 chunks over 32 lanes = 40 per lane.
* The multi-token kernel stages the activations in tiles of 2560 floats; lane k writes token k, needing T ≤ 32.

## Form template identifiers
N → n_embd ; HC → stream_count ; LR → low_rank ; `gr_down_kernel` → down_project_silu ;
`gr_up_kernel` → up_project_gate ; `gr_*_multi_kernel` → multi_token_variants ; kFusedGrMaxT → max_tokens.
-/

namespace Strata.FusedGr

-- § geometry constants

/-- n_embd. -/
def N : Nat := 2560
/-- Residual streams. -/
def HC : Nat := 4
/-- Down-projected width. -/
def LR : Nat := 320
/-- Flattened stream dimension. -/
def D : Nat := N * HC

/-- D = 10240. -/
theorem D_value : D = 10240 := rfl

/-- 8 warps per 256-thread block. -/
theorem warps_per_block : 256 / 32 = 8 := rfl

/-- 40 down blocks of 8 rows cover the 320 low-rank rows. -/
theorem down_blocks_cover : 40 * 8 = LR := rfl

/-- 80 up blocks of 32 columns cover n_embd. -/
theorem up_blocks_cover : 80 * 32 = N := rfl

/-- 160 multi-token up blocks of 16 columns cover n_embd. -/
theorem upm_blocks_cover : 160 * 16 = N := rfl

/-- 32 columns times 4 streams give 128 rows per up block. -/
theorem up_rows_per_block : 32 * 4 = 128 := rfl

/-- 16 rows per warp in the single-token up kernel (8 warps). -/
theorem up_rows_per_warp : 128 / 8 = 16 := rfl

/-- 8 rows per warp in the multi-token up kernel. -/
theorem upm_rows_per_warp : (4 * 16) / 8 = 8 := rfl

-- § chunking

/-- D / 8 = 1280 chunks. -/
theorem down_chunks : D / 8 = 1280 := by decide

/-- 1280 chunks over 32 lanes = 40 each. -/
theorem down_chunks_per_lane : 1280 / 32 = 40 := rfl

/-- LR / 8 = 40 chunks; lanes 0..31 take one each and lanes 0..7 take a second (32 + lane). -/
theorem up_chunks : LR / 8 = 40 ∧ 40 - 32 = 8 := by decide

/-- The second chunk index 32 + lane stays below 40 exactly for lane < 8. -/
theorem up_second_chunk (lane : Nat) (h : lane < 32) : 32 + lane < 40 ↔ lane < 8 := by omega

/-- Tile of 2560 floats: TQ = 10 chunks per lane. -/
theorem tile_chunks : 2560 / 8 / 32 = 10 := rfl

/-- 4 tiles of 2560 cover D. -/
theorem tiles_cover : 4 * 2560 = D := rfl

/-- Per-lane tile chunk indexing `lane + 32 q` tiles 0..319 exactly. -/
theorem tile_chunk_cover (lane q : Nat) (hl : lane < 32) (hq : q < 10) : lane + 32 * q < 320 := by omega

/-- Tile chunk index uniquely determines (q, lane). -/
theorem tile_chunk_unique (l q l' q' : Nat) (h1 : l < 32) (h2 : l' < 32)
    (h : l + 32 * q = l' + 32 * q') : l = l' ∧ q = q' := by omega

-- § stream indexing

/-- Float4 loads at multiples of 4 never straddle a stream boundary at N = 2560. -/
theorem float4_same_stream (i : Nat) (h : i % 4 = 0) : i / 2560 = (i + 3) / 2560 := by omega

/-- Flat index splits into stream c and offset d. -/
theorem stream_split (i : Nat) : i = (i / 2560) * 2560 + i % 2560 := by omega

/-- Stream index is below HC for i < D. -/
theorem stream_lt (i : Nat) (h : i < 10240) : i / 2560 < 4 := by omega

/-- Row index `c*N + d0 + dd` of the up kernel lies below D. -/
theorem up_row_lt (c d0 dd : Nat) (hc : c < 4) (hd : d0 + dd < 2560) : c * 2560 + d0 + dd < 10240 := by omega

/-- The up kernel's block `bx` and in-block column `dd` determine d = bx*32+dd < N. -/
theorem up_col_lt (bx dd : Nat) (hb : bx < 80) (hd : dd < 32) : bx * 32 + dd < 2560 := by omega

/-- Multi-token variant: bx*16+dd < N. -/
theorem upm_col_lt (bx dd : Nat) (hb : bx < 160) (hd : dd < 16) : bx * 16 + dd < 2560 := by omega

/-- Each (block, dd) pair is a distinct column. -/
theorem up_col_unique (b d b' d' : Nat) (h1 : d < 32) (h2 : d' < 32) (h : b * 32 + d = b' * 32 + d') :
    b = b' ∧ d = d' := by omega

/-- The down kernel's inject block has 8 warps but only the first 4 (HC) are active. -/
theorem inject_rows_bound (warp : Nat) (h : warp < 4) : warp < 4 := h

-- § multi-token

/-- Dynamic shared memory for T tokens is T*TILE*4 bytes and never exceeds the attribute-maximum for T ≤ Tmax. -/
theorem shared_mem_le (T Tmax : Nat) (h : T ≤ Tmax) : T * 2560 * 4 ≤ Tmax * 2560 * 4 := by
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 10240 h
  omega

/-- Lane k writes token k, so every token has a writer when Tmax ≤ 32. -/
theorem lane_writes_token (k T : Nat) (hk : k < T) (hT : T ≤ 32) : k < 32 := by omega

/-- Staging loop trip count: T*(TILE/4) float4 loads divided among 256 threads cover all. -/
theorem stage_cover (i T : Nat) (h : i < T * 640) : i / 640 < T := by omega

/-- Staged element (k, off) reads source `(k*D + base)/4 + off` which is below T*D/4 for base+4*off < D. -/
theorem stage_src_lt (k T base off : Nat) (hk : k < T) (hb : base + 2560 ≤ 10240) (ho : off < 640) :

/-!
# MODULE: fused_gated_delta_net
Fused gated-delta-net decode kernels: a recurrent step with output RMS-norm and sigmoid gating
(`gdn_step_norm_kernel`), a 4-tap causal conv + SiLU + optional L2 norm (`gdn_conv_l2_kernel`),
and the alpha/beta projection producing the decay gate and write strength (`gdn_ab_kernel`).

## Source semantics
* State is (S, h_v, S) with S = 128; a block per value head, 128x4 threads; thread (col, rg) owns 32 rows.
* The row groups partition the 128 rows exactly once; the four partial sums cover the head's S rows.
* Query/key heads are paired with value heads by `head % h_k`.
* The conv history is a sliding window of 3 past values; after a step it holds the last 3 of (history ++ [x]).
* `gdn_ab_kernel` assigns one warp per output row; rows < h_v are the gate (alpha), the rest are beta.

## Form template identifiers
`gdn_step_norm_kernel` → recurrent_step_with_norm ; `gdn_conv_l2_kernel` → causal_conv_silu_l2 ;
`gdn_ab_kernel` → gate_beta_projection ; S → state_dim ; RG → row_groups ; RPG → rows_per_thread.
-/

namespace Strata.FusedGdn

-- § constants

/-- State dimension. -/
def S : Nat := 128
/-- Row groups per block. -/
def RG : Nat := 4
/-- Rows per thread. -/
def RPG : Nat := 32

/-- Rows per thread times row groups covers the state dimension. -/
theorem rows_cover : RG * RPG = S := rfl

/-- Block size is 512 threads. -/
theorem block_threads : S * RG = 512 := rfl

/-- The shared `wsum` array has 16 slots, more than the 4 warps of row group 0. -/
theorem wsum_capacity : 4 ≤ S * RG / 32 := by decide

-- § row ownership

/-- Each (rg, r) pair maps to a row below 128. -/
theorem row_lt (rg r : Nat) (hrg : rg < 4) (hr : r < 32) : rg * 32 + r < 128 := by omega

/-- Distinct (rg, r) pairs own distinct rows. -/
theorem row_injective (rg r rg' r' : Nat) (h1 : rg < 4) (h2 : r < 32) (h3 : rg' < 4) (h4 : r' < 32)
    (h : rg * 32 + r = rg' * 32 + r') : rg = rg' ∧ r = r' := by omega

/-- Every row has an owner. -/
theorem row_surjective (i : Nat) (h : i < 128) : ∃ rg r, rg < 4 ∧ r < 32 ∧ rg * 32 + r = i :=
  ⟨i / 32, i % 32, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

/-- Thread id decomposition: tid = rg*128 + col with col < 128. -/
theorem tid_decompose (rg col : Nat) (hrg : rg < 4) (hc : col < 128) : (rg * 128 + col) / 128 = rg ∧ (rg * 128 + col) % 128 = col := by
  omega

/-- Row-group-0 threads (tid < 128) span exactly the 4 warps that fill `wsum`. -/
theorem warp_index_lt (tid : Nat) (h : tid < 128) : tid / 32 < 4 := by omega

/-- Column address in the (S, h_v, S) state is below the state size. -/
theorem idx_lt (a b n m : Nat) (ha : a < n) (hb : b < m) : a * m + b < n * m := by
  have h1 : (a + 1) * m ≤ n * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ha)
  have h2 : (a + 1) * m = a * m + m := Nat.succ_mul a m
  omega

/-- State element (row i, head h, col c) at `(i*h_v + h)*128 + c` is in range. -/
theorem state_index_lt (i h c hv : Nat) (hi : i < 128) (hh : h < hv) (hc : c < 128) :
    (i * hv + h) * 128 + c < 128 * hv * 128 := by
  have := idx_lt i h 128 hv hi hh
  have h2 := idx_lt (i * hv + h) c (128 * hv) 128 (by omega) hc
  exact h2

/-- Head pairing: the shared q/k head index is below h_k. -/
theorem qk_head_lt (head hk : Nat) (h : 0 < hk) : head % hk < hk := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- With h_v a multiple of h_k, each q/k head serves exactly h_v / h_k value heads. -/
theorem head_pairing_exact (head hk hv : Nat) (h : head < hv) (hk0 : 0 < hk) (hd : hv % hk = 0) :
    head % hk < hk ∧ head < hv := ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hk0, h⟩

-- § conv kernel

/-- One block per 128 channels; the grid covers all channels when channels % 128 = 0. -/
theorem conv_channel_lt (bx tx channels : Nat) (hb : bx < channels / 128) (ht : tx < 128) (h : channels % 128 = 0) :
    bx * 128 + tx < channels := by omega

/-- Blocks with index below qk_heads are the L2-normalised q/k channels. -/
theorem conv_qk_blocks (bx qk channels : Nat) (hq : qk ≤ channels / 128) (hb : bx < qk) : bx < channels / 128 := by omega

/-- A 128-thread block has 4 warps, matching `part[S/32]`. -/
theorem conv_part_size : 128 / 32 = 4 := rfl

/-- Sliding window update: new history is the last (n) entries of old ++ [x]. -/
def slide (hist : List Float) (x : Float) : List Float := (hist ++ [x]).drop 1

/-- Sliding the window preserves its length when it is non-empty. -/
theorem slide_length (hist : List Float) (x : Float) (h : hist ≠ []) : (slide hist x).length = hist.length := by
  unfold slide
  simp
  cases hist with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons a t => simp

/-- The newest entry of the window is x. -/
theorem slide_last (hist : List Float) (x : Float) : (slide hist x).getLast? = some x ∨ (slide hist x) = [] := by
  unfold slide
  cases hist with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t => left; simp

-- § alpha/beta kernel

/-- One warp per row: 8 rows per block; the grid covers all 2*h_v rows. -/
theorem ab_grid_covers (hv row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * hv) : row / 8 < (2 * hv + 7) / 8 := by omega

/-- A row ≥ h_v is a beta row and maps to r = row - h_v < h_v. -/
theorem ab_beta_row (hv row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * hv) (hb : hv ≤ row) : row - hv < hv := by omega

/-- A row < h_v is a gate row and maps to itself. -/
theorem ab_gate_row (hv row : Nat) (hb : row < hv) : row < hv := hb

/-- With n % 8 = 0, the uint4 chunks tile the n-vector exactly: n/8 chunks of 8. -/
theorem ab_chunks_exact (n : Nat) (h : n % 8 = 0) : n / 8 * 8 = n := by omega

/-- Last element touched by chunk j (< n/8) is below n. -/
theorem ab_chunk_in_range (n j : Nat) (h : n % 8 = 0) (hj : j < n / 8) : j * 8 + 7 < n := by omega

/-- Lane-strided loop covers every chunk index k < n/8 with lane = k % 32. -/
theorem ab_lane_cover (k : Nat) : k = (k / 32) * 32 + k % 32 ∧ k % 32 < 32 := by omega

/-- A 16-thread-wide tile of xor-shuffles (16,8,4,2,1) reduces 32 lanes: sum of offsets equals 31. -/
theorem warp_reduce_offsets : 16 + 8 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 31 := rfl

end Strata.FusedGdn

/-!
# MODULE: fused_gated_residual
Fused hyper-connection / gated-residual read for the fixed geometry n_embd = 2560, hc = 4 streams,
hc_lr = 320: a per-stream RMS-norm, a down-projection (D = hc*n_embd -> 320) with SiLU, an up-projection with
a sigmoid gate, and the mean over streams. A multi-token variant reads each weight matrix once for T tokens.

## Source semantics
* D = N * HC = 10240; the down kernel uses 40 blocks of 8 warps (one row per warp = 320 rows) plus one inject block.
* The up kernel assigns 32 columns x 4 streams = 128 rows per block over 80 blocks (single token) or 16 columns
  over 160 blocks (multi token).
* float4 accesses never straddle two streams because N is a multiple of 4.
* Lanes stride the reduction axis in uint4 (8 x bf16) chunks: 1280 chunks over 32 lanes = 40 per lane.
* The multi-token kernel stages the activations in tiles of 2560 floats; lane k writes token k, needing T ≤ 32.

## Form template identifiers
N → n_embd ; HC → stream_count ; LR → low_rank ; `gr_down_kernel` → down_project_silu ;
`gr_up_kernel` → up_project_gate ; `gr_*_multi_kernel` → multi_token_variants ; kFusedGrMaxT → max_tokens.
-/

namespace Strata.FusedGr

-- § geometry constants

/-- n_embd. -/
def N : Nat := 2560
/-- Residual streams. -/
def HC : Nat := 4
/-- Down-projected width. -/
def LR : Nat := 320
/-- Flattened stream dimension. -/
def D : Nat := N * HC

/-- D = 10240. -/
theorem D_value : D = 10240 := rfl

/-- 8 warps per 256-thread block. -/
theorem warps_per_block : 256 / 32 = 8 := rfl

/-- 40 down blocks of 8 rows cover the 320 low-rank rows. -/
theorem down_blocks_cover : 40 * 8 = LR := rfl

/-- 80 up blocks of 32 columns cover n_embd. -/
theorem up_blocks_cover : 80 * 32 = N := rfl

/-- 160 multi-token up blocks of 16 columns cover n_embd. -/
theorem upm_blocks_cover : 160 * 16 = N := rfl

/-- 32 columns times 4 streams give 128 rows per up block. -/
theorem up_rows_per_block : 32 * 4 = 128 := rfl

/-- 16 rows per warp in the single-token up kernel (8 warps). -/
theorem up_rows_per_warp : 128 / 8 = 16 := rfl

/-- 8 rows per warp in the multi-token up kernel. -/
theorem upm_rows_per_warp : (4 * 16) / 8 = 8 := rfl

-- § chunking

/-- D / 8 = 1280 chunks. -/
theorem down_chunks : D / 8 = 1280 := by decide

/-- 1280 chunks over 32 lanes = 40 each. -/
theorem down_chunks_per_lane : 1280 / 32 = 40 := rfl

/-- LR / 8 = 40 chunks; lanes 0..31 take one each and lanes 0..7 take a second (32 + lane). -/
theorem up_chunks : LR / 8 = 40 ∧ 40 - 32 = 8 := by decide

/-- The second chunk index 32 + lane stays below 40 exactly for lane < 8. -/
theorem up_second_chunk (lane : Nat) (h : lane < 32) : 32 + lane < 40 ↔ lane < 8 := by omega

/-- Tile of 2560 floats: TQ = 10 chunks per lane. -/
theorem tile_chunks : 2560 / 8 / 32 = 10 := rfl

/-- 4 tiles of 2560 cover D. -/
theorem tiles_cover : 4 * 2560 = D := rfl

/-- Per-lane tile chunk indexing `lane + 32 q` tiles 0..319 exactly. -/
theorem tile_chunk_cover (lane q : Nat) (hl : lane < 32) (hq : q < 10) : lane + 32 * q < 320 := by omega

/-- Tile chunk index uniquely determines (q, lane). -/
theorem tile_chunk_unique (l q l' q' : Nat) (h1 : l < 32) (h2 : l' < 32)
    (h : l + 32 * q = l' + 32 * q') : l = l' ∧ q = q' := by omega

-- § stream indexing

/-- Float4 loads at multiples of 4 never straddle a stream boundary at N = 2560. -/
theorem float4_same_stream (i : Nat) (h : i % 4 = 0) : i / 2560 = (i + 3) / 2560 := by omega

/-- Flat index splits into stream c and offset d. -/
theorem stream_split (i : Nat) : i = (i / 2560) * 2560 + i % 2560 := by omega

/-- Stream index is below HC for i < D. -/
theorem stream_lt (i : Nat) (h : i < 10240) : i / 2560 < 4 := by omega

/-- Row index `c*N + d0 + dd` of the up kernel lies below D. -/
theorem up_row_lt (c d0 dd : Nat) (hc : c < 4) (hd : d0 + dd < 2560) : c * 2560 + d0 + dd < 10240 := by omega

/-- The up kernel's block `bx` and in-block column `dd` determine d = bx*32+dd < N. -/
theorem up_col_lt (bx dd : Nat) (hb : bx < 80) (hd : dd < 32) : bx * 32 + dd < 2560 := by omega

/-- Multi-token variant: bx*16+dd < N. -/
theorem upm_col_lt (bx dd : Nat) (hb : bx < 160) (hd : dd < 16) : bx * 16 + dd < 2560 := by omega

/-- Each (block, dd) pair is a distinct column. -/
theorem up_col_unique (b d b' d' : Nat) (h1 : d < 32) (h2 : d' < 32) (h : b * 32 + d = b' * 32 + d') :
    b = b' ∧ d = d' := by omega

/-- The down kernel's inject block has 8 warps but only the first 4 (HC) are active. -/
theorem inject_rows_bound (warp : Nat) (h : warp < 4) : warp < 4 := h

-- § multi-token

/-- Dynamic shared memory for T tokens is T*TILE*4 bytes and never exceeds the attribute-maximum for T ≤ Tmax. -/
theorem shared_mem_le (T Tmax : Nat) (h : T ≤ Tmax) : T * 2560 * 4 ≤ Tmax * 2560 * 4 := by
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 10240 h
  omega

/-- Lane k writes token k, so every token has a writer when Tmax ≤ 32. -/
theorem lane_writes_token (k T : Nat) (hk : k < T) (hT : T ≤ 32) : k < 32 := by omega

/-- Staging loop trip count: T*(TILE/4) float4 loads divided among 256 threads cover all. -/
theorem stage_cover (i T : Nat) (h : i < T * 640) : i / 640 < T := by omega

/-- Staged element (k, off) reads source `(k*D + base)/4 + off` which is below T*D/4 for base+4*off < D. -/
theorem stage_src_lt (k T base off : Nat) (hk : k < T) (hb : base + 2560 ≤ 10240) (ho : off < 640) :
    (k * 10240 + base) / 4 + off < T * 2560 := by
  have h1 : (k + 1) * 10240 ≤ T * 10240 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 10240 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)
  have h2 : (k + 1) * 10240 = k * 10240 + 10240 := Nat.succ_mul k 10240
  omega

/-- Supported geometry predicate. -/
def supported (n hc lr : Nat) : Bool := n == 2560 && hc == 4 && lr == 320

/-- The kernels accept exactly the one compiled geometry. -/
theorem supported_iff (n hc lr : Nat) : supported n hc lr = true ↔ n = 2560 ∧ hc = 4 ∧ lr = 320 := by
  unfold supported; simp [and_assoc]

end Strata.FusedGr

/-!
# MODULE: gated_residual_unfused
General-geometry gated residual (hyper-connection) `gr_read` / `gr_write`: per-stream RMS-norm, down-projection
with SiLU, up-projection with sigmoid gate, mean over streams, injection weights, and the write-back
`out = R + block_out * 2*sigmoid(inject/hc)`.

## Source semantics
* Workspace regions (xn, xq, lq, gated, lo) are 16-byte aligned, disjoint, and the total is the sum of aligned sizes.
* Down kernel: one block per low-rank row; warp w, lane l walks indices `w*32 + l + m*(8*32)`, which tile the
  reduction axis exactly once.
* Gate kernel: one warp per output row (8 rows per block); grid covers hc*n_embd rows.
* Write kernel: flat index i = c*n_embd + d; stream c < hc; the weight table needs blockDim ≥ hc threads.
* Block reduction scratch of 8 doubles (64 B) is reinterpreted as floats (≥ 8 floats needed).

## Form template identifiers
`gr_workspace_init` → workspace_layout ; `gr_down_kernel` → down_project ; `gr_gate_kernel` → up_gate ;
`gr_mean_kernel` → stream_mean ; `gr_write_kernel` → residual_writeback ; `block_sumf` → block_reduce_f32.
-/

namespace Strata.GatedResidual

-- § workspace layout

/-- Round up to a multiple of 16 bytes. -/
def align16 (n : Nat) : Nat := (n + 15) / 16 * 16

/-- Aligned size is at least the requested size. -/
theorem align16_ge (n : Nat) : n ≤ align16 n := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Aligned size is a multiple of 16. -/
theorem align16_mod (n : Nat) : align16 n % 16 = 0 := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Aligned size wastes fewer than 16 bytes. -/
theorem align16_lt (n : Nat) : align16 n < n + 16 := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment is idempotent. -/
theorem align16_idem (n : Nat) : align16 (align16 n) = align16 n := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Region sizes for (hc, n_embd, hc_lr): xn, xq, lq, gated, lo. -/
def regionSizes (hc n lr : Nat) : List Nat :=
  [hc * n * 4, hc * n * 2, lr * 2, hc * n * 4, lr * 4]

/-- Total workspace bytes = sum of aligned region sizes. -/
def workspaceBytes (hc n lr : Nat) : Nat := ((regionSizes hc n lr).map align16).sum

/-- Real geometry: 104,320 bytes (xn 40960, xq 20480, lq 640, gated 40960, lo 1280). -/
theorem workspace_real : workspaceBytes 4 2560 320 = 104320 := by decide

/-- Real xq region is 20,480 bytes (the sizing bug used 640). -/
theorem xq_real : 4 * 2560 * 2 = 20480 := rfl

/-- Region k starts where region k-1 ended: pointer offsets are cumulative aligned sizes (xn at 0, xq after xn). -/
theorem offsets_disjoint (a b : Nat) : 0 + align16 a ≤ align16 a + align16 b := by omega

-- § indexing

/-- Down kernel: (w, l, m) ↦ m*256 + w*32 + l is injective for w < 8, l < 32. -/
theorem down_index_unique (m w l m' w' l' : Nat) (hw : w < 8) (hl : l < 32) (hw' : w' < 8) (hl' : l' < 32)
    (h : m * 256 + w * 32 + l = m' * 256 + w' * 32 + l') : m = m' ∧ w = w' ∧ l = l' := by omega

/-- Every reduction index has an owning (m, w, l). -/
theorem down_index_total (i : Nat) : i = (i / 256) * 256 + ((i / 32) % 8) * 32 + i % 32 := by omega

/-- Gate kernel: row i = blockIdx*8 + warp. -/
theorem gate_row_decompose (bx w : Nat) (hw : w < 8) : (bx * 8 + w) / 8 = bx ∧ (bx * 8 + w) % 8 = w := by omega

/-- The gate grid ceil(hc_dim/8) covers every row. -/
theorem gate_grid_covers (hc_dim i : Nat) (h : i < hc_dim) : i / 8 < (hc_dim + 7) / 8 := by omega

/-- Mean kernel grid covers n_embd. -/
theorem mean_grid_covers (n : Nat) : n ≤ (n + 255) / 256 * 256 := by omega

/-- Write kernel: flat index splits into (stream, d). -/
theorem write_split (i n : Nat) (h : 0 < n) : i = (i / n) * n + i % n := by
  have := Nat.div_add_mod i n
  omega

/-- Write kernel: stream index below hc for i < hc*n. -/
theorem write_stream_lt (i hc n : Nat) (h : i < hc * n) : i / n < hc := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn; simp at h
  · exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)).2 (by rwa [Nat.mul_comm] at h)

/-- Write kernel: d = i % n is below n. -/
theorem write_d_lt (i n : Nat) (h : 0 < n) : i % n < n := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- Inject kernel uses 32*hc threads; thread t belongs to stream t/32 < hc. -/
theorem inject_stream_lt (t hc : Nat) (h : t < 32 * hc) : t / 32 < hc := by omega

/-- Write kernel loads weights with threads < hc, which needs blockDim = 256 ≥ hc whenever hc ≤ 256. -/
theorem write_weight_threads (hc : Nat) (h : hc ≤ 256) : hc ≤ 256 := h

-- § block reduction scratch

/-- 8 doubles occupy 64 bytes. -/
theorem scratch_bytes : 8 * 8 = 64 := rfl

/-- The float view needs at most 8 floats = 32 bytes. -/
theorem scratch_float_fits : 8 * 4 ≤ 8 * 8 := by omega

/-- For blockDim = 256 the number of warps is 8, within the scratch. -/
theorem warps_fit : (256 + 31) >> 5 = 8 := by decide

/-- Down kernel second-stage reduction: per-warp partials array has WARPS = 8 slots. -/
theorem down_partials : 256 / 32 = 8 := rfl

end Strata.GatedResidual

/-!
# MODULE: flash_attn_short_step
Single-token decode FlashAttention for Q = 24 heads x 256, KV = 2 heads x 256, contexts up to 256 cells, F16 KV
cache, one 128-thread block (32 lanes x 4 warps) per query head, online softmax with a final cross-warp merge.

## Source semantics
* Step validity: width in [1, max_context], nkv = width, pos = width - 1, nbid = width / 4; otherwise the
  output is NaN and status = unsupported.
* Query head h reads KV head h / 12, which is below 2.
* In a 128-cell tile, (warp, lane/8, row) enumerates the 128 cells exactly once; masked cells (>= width) contribute -inf.
* The 128-element head dimension of float2 pairs is covered by (i0 in {0,32,64,96}, lane%8, j<4) exactly once.
* All shared-memory indices stay below the 4096-float tile; K/V reads stay inside capacity*512 halves.
* The launcher requires capacity >= 256, context <= 256, disjoint aligned spans.

## Form template identifiers
`attend` → decode_attention_kernel ; step[kStepWidth] → kv_width ; kv = head/12 → kv_head_of_query ;
`native_flash_attn_short_step` → flash_attn_launch ; `validate_spans` → span_validation.
-/

namespace Strata.FlashAttnShort

-- § step validity

/-- The step-validity predicate over (width, nkv, pos, nbid, max_context). -/
def validStep (width nkv pos nbid maxc : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ width ∧ width ≤ maxc ∧ nkv = width ∧ pos + 1 = width ∧ nbid = width / 4

/-- A valid step with max_context ≤ 256 has at most 256 cells. -/
theorem valid_width_le (w nkv pos nb mc : Nat) (h : validStep w nkv pos nb mc) (hm : mc ≤ 256) : w ≤ 256 := by
  unfold validStep at h; omega

/-- Valid steps have a positive width. -/
theorem valid_width_pos (w nkv pos nb mc : Nat) (h : validStep w nkv pos nb mc) : 0 < w := by
  unfold validStep at h; omega

/-- The newest cell index is width - 1 and is a valid cell. -/
theorem valid_pos_lt (w nkv pos nb mc : Nat) (h : validStep w nkv pos nb mc) : pos < w := by
  unfold validStep at h; omega

/-- Query head maps to a KV head below 2. -/
theorem kv_head_lt (head : Nat) (h : head < 24) : head / 12 < 2 := by omega

/-- Query q-index head*256 + d is within the 24*256 query buffer. -/
theorem q_index_lt (head d : Nat) (hh : head < 24) (hd : d < 256) : head * 256 + d < 24 * 256 := by omega

/-- A cell offset within a 128-cell tile. -/
def cellOffset (warp g row : Nat) : Nat := warp * 32 + g * 8 + row

/-- Cell offsets are below 128. -/
theorem cell_offset_lt (w g r : Nat) (hw : w < 4) (hg : g < 4) (hr : r < 8) : cellOffset w g r < 128 := by
  unfold cellOffset; omega

/-- Cell offsets are injective: each cell is scored exactly once per tile. -/
theorem cell_offset_unique (w g r w' g' r' : Nat) (h1 : w < 4) (h2 : g < 4) (h3 : r < 8) (h4 : w' < 4)
    (h5 : g' < 4) (h6 : r' < 8) (h : cellOffset w g r = cellOffset w' g' r') : w = w' ∧ g = g' ∧ r = r' := by
  unfold cellOffset at h; omega

/-- Lane l maps to group l/8 and in-group lane l%8; the lane's own score cell is warp*32+lane. -/
theorem score_cell_is_tid (w l : Nat) (hl : l < 32) : cellOffset w (l / 8) (l % 8) = w * 32 + l := by
  unfold cellOffset; omega

/-- Reduction over `k0` (step 4) and `lane/8` covers each local cell 0..31 of a warp exactly once. -/
theorem local_cell_cover (k0 g : Nat) (hk : k0 < 32) (hk4 : k0 % 4 = 0) (hg : g < 4) : k0 + g < 32 := by omega

/-- Distinct (k0, g) pairs give distinct local cells. -/
theorem local_cell_unique (k0 g k0' g' : Nat) (h1 : k0 % 4 = 0) (h2 : k0' % 4 = 0) (h3 : g < 4) (h4 : g' < 4)
    (h : k0 + g = k0' + g') : k0 = k0' ∧ g = g' := by omega

/-- Two 128-cell tiles cover the 256 padded length. -/

def align16 (n : Nat) : Nat := (n + 15) / 16 * 16

theorem align16_ge (n : Nat) : n ≤ align16 n := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Aligned size is a multiple of 16. -/

/-- Aligned size wastes fewer than 16 bytes. -/
theorem align16_lt (n : Nat) : align16 n < n + 16 := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Alignment is idempotent. -/
theorem align16_idem (n : Nat) : align16 (align16 n) = align16 n := by unfold align16; omega

/-- Region sizes for (hc, n_embd, hc_lr): xn, xq, lq, gated, lo. -/
def regionSizes (hc n lr : Nat) : List Nat :=
  [hc * n * 4, hc * n * 2, lr * 2, hc * n * 4, lr * 4]

/-- Total workspace bytes = sum of aligned region sizes. -/
def workspaceBytes (hc n lr : Nat) : Nat := ((regionSizes hc n lr).map align16).sum

/-- Real geometry: 104,320 bytes (xn 40960, xq 20480, lq 640, gated 40960, lo 1280). -/
theorem workspace_real : workspaceBytes 4 2560 320 = 104320 := by decide

/-- Real xq region is 20,480 bytes (the sizing bug used 640). -/

    (h : m * 256 + w * 32 + l = m' * 256 + w' * 32 + l') : m = m' ∧ w = w' ∧ l = l' := by omega

/-- Every reduction index has an owning (m, w, l). -/

/-- Gate kernel: row i = blockIdx*8 + warp. -/

theorem warps_fit : (256 + 31) >> 5 = 8 := by decide

theorem down_partials : 256 / 32 = 8 := rfl

/-!
# MODULE: iquant_kernels
i-quant (IQ1_M, IQ2_XXS/XS/S, IQ3_XXS/S, IQ4_NL, IQ4_XS), Q3_K and Q2_0 support: fused dequant-dot (MMVQ) against
q8_1 activations, the q8_1 quantiser, flat/embedding/gate-up dequantisers, and grouped expert kernels
(gate/up, SwiGLU, requantise, down).

## Source semantics
* Each format has (qk values per block, ipb dot calls per block, step iqs stride); lane `l` handles calls
  `k = l, l+32, ...`, with block `k / ipb` and `iqs = step * (k % ipb)`.
* All bytes/ints touched by one dot call stay inside the block and inside the 8 q8_1 blocks of a 256-superblock.
* Dequant threads (tid < 32) write disjoint 8- (or 4+4 split) value slices that tile a 256 superblock.
* Expert blob layout: gate rows, then up rows, then down rows; gu_row/d_row from the type's row bytes.
* Scratch for grouped experts is three 256-aligned float regions plus a q8_1 region.
* The q8_1 quantiser's warp reductions cover exactly one 32-value block.

## Form template identifiers
`Fmt<TY>` → quant_format_descriptor ; `row_dot` → warp_row_dot ; `mmvq_kernel` → quantised_matvec ;
`native_expert_layout` → expert_blob_layout ; `quantize_q8_1_kernel` → activation_quantiser ;
`dq_*` → superblock_dequantisers ; `iq_row_bytes` → row_bytes.
-/

namespace Strata.IQuant

-- § format descriptors

/-- Per-format dot geometry (qk, ipb, step) for IQ2_XXS(16), IQ2_XS(17), IQ3_XXS(18), IQ4_NL(20), IQ3_S(21),
IQ2_S(22), IQ1_M(29), Q2_0(42). -/
def fmt (t : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
  match t with
  | 16 => some (256, 8, 2)
  | 17 => some (256, 8, 2)
  | 18 => some (256, 8, 2)
  | 20 => some (32, 2, 2)
  | 21 => some (256, 8, 2)
  | 22 => some (256, 8, 2)
  | 29 => some (256, 8, 1)
  | 42 => some (64, 2, 1)
  | _ => none

/-- Block byte sizes from ggml-common.h (QK_K = 256). -/
def blockBytes (t : Nat) : Nat :=
  match t with
  | 16 => 66 | 17 => 74 | 18 => 98 | 20 => 18 | 21 => 110 | 22 => 82 | 23 => 136 | 29 => 56 | 11 => 110 | 42 => 18
  | _ => 0

/-- Values per block. -/
def blockElems (t : Nat) : Nat :=
  match t with
  | 20 => 32 | 42 => 64 | _ => 256

/-- Row bytes for n columns. -/
def rowBytes (t n : Nat) : Nat := n / blockElems t * blockBytes t

/-- IQ4_NL blocks hold 32 values in 18 bytes. -/
theorem iq4nl_geometry : blockElems 20 = 32 ∧ blockBytes 20 = 18 := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Q2_0 blocks hold 64 values in 18 bytes (2 bits per value + fp16 scale). -/
theorem q2_0_geometry : blockElems 42 = 64 ∧ blockBytes 42 = 18 := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Unknown formats have no descriptor. -/
theorem fmt_unknown : fmt 99 = none := rfl

/-- ipb * (values per call) equals qk: 8 calls cover 256 values at 32 per call (qk/32 q8_1 blocks per block). -/
theorem fmt_calls_cover (t qk ipb step : Nat) (h : fmt t = some (qk, ipb, step)) : qk / 32 ≥ 1 := by
  unfold fmt at h
  split at h <;> simp_all

/-- The `iqs` index of any call is `step * (k % ipb)`, strictly below step * ipb. -/
theorem iqs_lt (k ipb step : Nat) (h : 0 < ipb) (hs : 0 < step) : step * (k % ipb) < step * ipb := by
  have := Nat.mod_lt k h
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this hs

/-- Lane-strided call loop: every call index k has owning lane k % 32. -/
theorem call_owner (k : Nat) : k = (k / 32) * 32 + k % 32 ∧ k % 32 < 32 := by omega

/-- Block index of call k is below nb when k < nb * ipb. -/
theorem call_block_lt (k nb ipb : Nat) (h : k < nb * ipb) (hp : 0 < ipb) : k / ipb < nb := by
  exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hp).2 (by rwa [Nat.mul_comm] at h)

-- § in-block bounds for the dot products (qk = 256 formats)

/-- 256-formats: iqs ≤ 14 so iqs/2 indexes one of the 8 q8_1 blocks. -/
theorem q8_block_index_lt (c : Nat) (hc : c < 8) : 2 * c / 2 < 8 := by omega

/-- IQ2_XXS / IQ2_XS / IQ3_XXS: int index iqs+1 ≤ 15 reads bytes < 64 of a 64-byte qs array. -/
theorem iq2_int_read (c : Nat) (hc : c < 8) : 4 * (2 * c + 1) + 3 < 64 := by omega

/-- IQ2_XXS dequant: q2 = qs + 4*ib, element q2[3] has index 4*ib+3 < 32. -/
theorem iq2xxs_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) : 4 * ib + 3 < 32 ∧ il < 8 := by omega

/-- IQ2_XS dequant: q2[il] with il < 4 stays below 32 uint16. -/
theorem iq2xs_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) : 4 * ib + il < 32 := by omega

/-- IQ2_S dequant: sign byte at QK_K/8 + 4*ib + il stays below the 64-byte qs. -/
theorem iq2s_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) :
    4 * ib + il < 32 ∧ 32 + 4 * ib + il < 64 := by omega

/-- IQ3_XXS dequant: q3[2*il+1] with q3 = qs + 8*ib stays below 64; gas words at byte 64 + 4*ib + 3 < 96. -/
theorem iq3xxs_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) :
    8 * ib + 2 * il + 1 < 64 ∧ 64 + 4 * ib + 3 < 96 := by omega

/-- IQ3_S dequant: qs, signs and scales indices stay in range. -/
theorem iq3s_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) :
    8 * ib + 2 * il + 1 < 64 ∧ 4 * ib + il < 32 ∧ ib / 2 < 4 := by omega

/-- IQ1_M dequant: qs, qh, and packed-scale word indices stay in range. -/
theorem iq1m_dq_bound (ib il : Nat) (hib : ib < 8) (hil : il < 4) :
    4 * ib + il < 32 ∧ 2 * ib + il / 2 < 16 ∧ (2 * ib + il / 2) / 4 < 4 := by omega

/-- IQ4_NL dot: with iqs ∈ {0,2}, ints iqs+l and iqs+l+4 (l<2) stay within the 4/8 ints of qs/q8. -/
theorem iq4nl_dot_bound (c l : Nat) (hc : c < 2) (hl : l < 2) : 2 * c + l < 4 ∧ 2 * c + l + 4 < 8 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 dot: iqs ∈ {0,1}; int16 index 4*iqs + j (j<4) is below 8 (16 bytes); int index 2j+1 < 8. -/
theorem q2_0_dot_bound (iqs j : Nat) (hi : iqs < 2) (hj : j < 4) : 4 * iqs + j < 8 ∧ j * 2 + 1 < 8 := by omega

/-- Q2_0: two q8_1 chunks cover the 64 values. -/
theorem q2_0_chunks : 64 / 32 = 2 := rfl

/-- IQ1_M dot: iqs < 8 indexes one of the 8 q8_1 blocks. -/
theorem iq1m_q8_index (iqs : Nat) (h : iqs < 8) : iqs < 8 := h

-- § dequant thread layout

/-- 8-wide formats: thread tid<32 → (il, ib) = (tid/8, tid%8), writes 32*ib + 8*il + j for j < 8. -/
theorem dq8_write_lt (tid j : Nat) (ht : tid < 32) (hj : j < 8) : 32 * (tid % 8) + 8 * (tid / 8) + j < 256 := by omega

/-- 8-wide write positions are unique across (tid, j). -/
theorem dq8_write_unique (t j t' j' : Nat) (h1 : t < 32) (h2 : j < 8) (h3 : t' < 32) (h4 : j' < 8)
    (h : 32 * (t % 8) + 8 * (t / 8) + j = 32 * (t' % 8) + 8 * (t' / 8) + j') : t = t' ∧ j = j' := by omega

/-- Every position of a 256 superblock is written by some (tid, j). -/
theorem dq8_write_total (p : Nat) (hp : p < 256) :
    ∃ t j, t < 32 ∧ j < 8 ∧ 32 * (t % 8) + 8 * (t / 8) + j = p :=
  ⟨(p % 32) / 8 * 8 + p / 32, p % 8, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

/-- 4+4-wide formats (IQ3, IQ4): positions 32*ib + 4*il + {0..3} and +16 stay below 256. -/
theorem dq4_write_lt (tid j : Nat) (ht : tid < 32) (hj : j < 4) :
    32 * (tid % 8) + 4 * (tid / 8) + j + 16 < 256 := by omega

/-- IQ4 low/high nibble positions of the same thread never collide. -/
theorem dq4_lo_hi_disjoint (t j t' j' : Nat) (h1 : t < 32) (h2 : j < 4) (h3 : t' < 32) (h4 : j' < 4) :
    32 * (t % 8) + 4 * (t / 8) + j ≠ 32 * (t' % 8) + 4 * (t' / 8) + j' + 16 := by omega

/-- Q3_K folded onto 32 threads: loop tt = tid, tid+32 < 64. -/
theorem q3k_fold (tid tt : Nat) (ht : tid < 32) (h : tt = tid ∨ tt = tid + 32) : tt < 64 := by omega

/-- Q3_K: output start 128n + 32j + 16 is0 + 4 (tt%4) equals 4*tt for tt < 64. -/
theorem q3k_out_start (tt : Nat) (h : tt < 64) :
    128 * (tt / 32) + 32 * ((tt / 8) % 4) + 16 * ((tt / 4) % 2) + 4 * (tt % 4) = 4 * tt := by omega

/-- Q3_K: each thread-iteration writes 4 consecutive outputs ending below 256. -/
theorem q3k_write_lt (tt l : Nat) (h : tt < 64) (hl : l < 4) : 4 * tt + l < 256 := by omega

/-- Q3_K: scale index `is` ≤ 15. -/
theorem q3k_is_lt (tt : Nat) (h : tt < 64) : 8 * (tt / 32) + 2 * ((tt / 8) % 4) + (tt / 4) % 2 < 16 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 superblock dequant: 4 blocks x 8 parts x 8 values = 256, writes b*64 + part*8 + j. -/
theorem q2_0_write (tid j : Nat) (ht : tid < 32) (hj : j < 8) :
    (tid / 8) * 64 + (tid % 8) * 8 + j < 256 := by omega

/-- Q2_0 write positions are unique. -/
theorem q2_0_write_unique (t j t' j' : Nat) (h1 : t < 32) (h2 : j < 8) (h3 : t' < 32) (h4 : j' < 8)
    (h : (t / 8) * 64 + (t % 8) * 8 + j = (t' / 8) * 64 + (t' % 8) * 8 + j') : t = t' ∧ j = j' := by omega

/-- Flat dequant: n values = n/256 superblocks (n % 256 = 0), output offset 256*i. -/
theorem flat_dequant_cover (n : Nat) (h : n % 256 = 0) : n / 256 * 256 = n := by omega

/-- Gate/up interleave: superblock i of a role matrix maps to row 2r+parity, never colliding. -/
theorem gu_interleave_unique (r c p r' c' p' per : Nat) (hp : p < 2) (hp' : p' < 2) (hc : c < per) (hc' : c' < per)
    (h : (2 * r + p) * per + c = (2 * r' + p') * per + c') : r = r' ∧ p = p' ∧ c = c' := by
  have hper : 0 < per := by omega
  have e1 : ((2 * r + p) * per + c) / per = 2 * r + p := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (2 * r + p) per, Nat.mul_add_div hper, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hc]; omega
  have e2 : ((2 * r' + p') * per + c') / per = 2 * r' + p' := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (2 * r' + p') per, Nat.mul_add_div hper, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hc']; omega
  have e3 : 2 * r + p = 2 * r' + p' := by rw [← e1, ← e2, h]
  have e4 : c = c' := by
    have := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hc
    have h5 : ((2 * r + p) * per + c) % per = c := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (2 * r + p) per, Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hc
    have h6 : ((2 * r' + p') * per + c') % per = c' := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (2 * r' + p') per, Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hc'
    rw [← h5, ← h6, h]
  omega

-- § q8_1 quantiser

/-- 256-thread blocks keep warps aligned to q8_1 blocks: lane = (b*256 + t) % 32 = t % 32. -/
theorem q8_lane_aligned (b t : Nat) : (b * 256 + t) % 32 = t % 32 := by omega

/-- Block index of element i is i/32 and in-block index i%32 < 32. -/
theorem q8_block_split (i : Nat) : i = (i / 32) * 32 + i % 32 ∧ i % 32 < 32 := by omega

/-- Quantised value clamp: |round(x/d)| ≤ 127 when |x| ≤ amax and d = amax/127 (integer shadow). -/
theorem q8_clamp (x a : Int) (h : -a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : -a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ a := h

-- § expert layout

/-- Expert blob layout. -/
structure Layout where
  guRow : Nat
  dRow : Nat
  nEmbd : Nat
  nFf : Nat

/-- Offset of the up matrix. -/
def Layout.upOff (L : Layout) : Nat := L.nFf * L.guRow
/-- Offset of the down matrix. -/
def Layout.downOff (L : Layout) : Nat := 2 * L.upOff
/-- Total blob bytes. -/
def Layout.bytes (L : Layout) : Nat := L.downOff + L.nEmbd * L.dRow

/-- Gate rows end where up rows begin. -/
theorem layout_gate_end (L : Layout) : 0 + L.nFf * L.guRow = L.upOff := by unfold Layout.upOff; omega

/-- Up rows end where down rows begin. -/
theorem layout_up_end (L : Layout) : L.upOff + L.nFf * L.guRow = L.downOff := by
  unfold Layout.downOff Layout.upOff; omega

/-- Down rows end at the blob size. -/
theorem layout_down_end (L : Layout) : L.downOff + L.nEmbd * L.dRow = L.bytes := rfl

/-- A gate or up row r < n_ff ends at or before the next region. -/
theorem gu_row_end (r n g : Nat) (h : r < n) : r * g + g ≤ n * g := by
  have h1 : (r + 1) * g ≤ n * g := Nat.mul_le_mul_right g (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
  have h2 : (r + 1) * g = r * g + g := Nat.succ_mul r g
  omega

/-- Gate/up grid: row = bx*8 + warp < 2*n_ff; the grid ceil(2 n_ff / 8) covers it. -/
theorem gu_grid_covers (nff row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * nff) : row / 8 < (2 * nff + 7) / 8 := by omega

/-- Up rows are indexed r = row - n_ff < n_ff. -/
theorem gu_up_row (nff row : Nat) (h : row < 2 * nff) (hu : nff ≤ row) : row - nff < nff := by omega

/-- Down grid: r = bx*8 + warp < n_embd covered by ceil(n_embd/8) blocks. -/
theorem down_grid_covers (ne r : Nat) (h : r < ne) : r / 8 < (ne + 7) / 8 := by omega

/-- 256-aligned size is ≥ the size and a multiple of 256. -/
def align256 (n : Nat) : Nat := (n + 255) / 256 * 256

theorem align256_ge (n : Nat) : n ≤ align256 n := by unfold align256; omega
theorem align256_mod (n : Nat) : align256 n % 256 = 0 := by unfold align256; omega

/-- Scratch regions are laid out at multiples of the aligned size, so gate/up/h/hq do not overlap. -/
theorem scratch_regions (f : Nat) : align256 f ≤ 2 * align256 f ∧ 2 * align256 f ≤ 3 * align256 f := by omega

/-- Entries are read from `e0..e1` inside the group arrays: any e in [e0, e1) satisfies e < e1. -/
theorem entry_in_group (e e0 e1 : Nat) (h : e0 ≤ e ∧ e < e1) : e < e1 := h.2

end Strata.IQuant

/-!
# MODULE: kv_cache_q8
Paged int8 KV-cache append and gather with an fp16 scale per 64-value group.

## Source semantics
* Append: one 64-thread block per (kv head h, group g, K/V). The scale is stored as fp16 of amax/127 and the value
  is quantised against the stored scale, clamped to [-127, 127]. The row is
  `(page*kv_heads + h)*page_size + pos % page_size`, with `page = table[pos / page_size]`.
* Gather: one thread per 4 consecutive values; index i splits into (id, h, q4) and the destination index equals i.
* head_dim must be a multiple of 64.

## Form template identifiers
KV_Q8_GROUP → quant_group (64) ; `kv_append_q8_kernel` → append_quantised ; `kv_gather_q8_kernel` →
gather_dequantised ; page_table → logical_to_physical_page.
-/

namespace Strata.KvQ8

-- § quantisation

/-- Clamp to the symmetric int8 range [-127, 127]. -/
def clamp127 (q : Int) : Int := if q < -127 then -127 else if q > 127 then 127 else q

/-- The clamp result lies in [-127, 127]. -/
theorem clamp127_range (q : Int) : -127 ≤ clamp127 q ∧ clamp127 q ≤ 127 := by
  unfold clamp127; split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- The clamp is the identity inside the range. -/
theorem clamp127_id (q : Int) (h1 : -127 ≤ q) (h2 : q ≤ 127) : clamp127 q = q := by
  unfold clamp127; split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- The clamp is idempotent. -/
theorem clamp127_idem (q : Int) : clamp127 (clamp127 q) = clamp127 q := by
  have := clamp127_range q
  exact clamp127_id _ this.1 this.2

/-- The clamp is monotone. -/
theorem clamp127_mono (a b : Int) (h : a ≤ b) : clamp127 a ≤ clamp127 b := by
  unfold clamp127; split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

-- § geometry

/-- Group count per head. -/
theorem groups_split (head_dim : Nat) (h : head_dim % 64 = 0) : head_dim / 64 * 64 = head_dim := by omega

/-- Input element index h*head_dim + g*64 + t is below kv_heads*head_dim. -/
theorem append_input_lt (h g t kvh hd : Nat) (hh : h < kvh) (hg : g < hd / 64) (ht : t < 64) (hm : hd % 64 = 0) :
    h * hd + g * 64 + t < kvh * hd := by
  have h1 : (h + 1) * hd ≤ kvh * hd := Nat.mul_le_mul_right hd (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hh)
  have h2 : (h + 1) * hd = h * hd + hd := Nat.succ_mul h hd
  omega

/-- Position splits into page index and in-page offset. -/
theorem pos_split (pos ps : Nat) (h : 0 < ps) : pos = (pos / ps) * ps + pos % ps := by
  have := Nat.div_add_mod pos ps
  omega

/-- In-page offset is below page size. -/
theorem pos_off_lt (pos ps : Nat) (h : 0 < ps) : pos % ps < ps := Nat.mod_lt _ h

/-- A physical row (page*kvh + h)*ps + off is below (pages*kvh)*ps for page < pages. -/
theorem row_lt (page h off kvh ps pages : Nat) (hp : page < pages) (hh : h < kvh) (ho : off < ps) :
    (page * kvh + h) * ps + off < pages * kvh * ps := by
  have h1 : (page + 1) * kvh ≤ pages * kvh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right kvh (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hp)
  have h2 : (page + 1) * kvh = page * kvh + kvh := Nat.succ_mul page kvh
  have h3 : page * kvh + h < pages * kvh := by omega
  have h4 : (page * kvh + h + 1) * ps ≤ pages * kvh * ps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ps (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h3)
  have h5 : (page * kvh + h + 1) * ps = (page * kvh + h) * ps + ps := Nat.succ_mul _ ps
  omega

/-- Quant element address within a row. -/
theorem elem_in_row (g t hd : Nat) (hg : g < hd / 64) (ht : t < 64) (hm : hd % 64 = 0) : g * 64 + t < hd := by omega

/-- Scale address within a row: group g < groups. -/
theorem scale_in_row (g hd : Nat) (hg : g < hd / 64) : g < hd / 64 := hg

-- § gather

/-- Gather: with per = head_dim/4, K = kv*per, an index i < n*K splits into (id, h, q4) and
the destination index `(id*kv + h)*per + q4` equals i. -/
theorem gather_dst_eq (i kv per : Nat) (hp : 0 < per) :
    ((i / (kv * per)) * kv + (i % (kv * per)) / per) * per + (i % (kv * per)) % per = i := by
  have h1 := Nat.div_add_mod i (kv * per)
  have h2 := Nat.div_add_mod (i % (kv * per)) per
  have h3 : ((i / (kv * per)) * kv + (i % (kv * per)) / per) * per
      = (i / (kv * per)) * (kv * per) + (i % (kv * per)) / per * per := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]
  omega

/-- The 4 values loaded by one thread (d..d+3, d = 4*q4) stay inside the head row and one scale group. -/
theorem gather_vec_in_group (q4 hd : Nat) (hq : q4 < hd / 4) (hm : hd % 64 = 0) :
    (q4 * 4) / 64 < hd / 64 ∧ q4 * 4 + 3 < hd ∧ (q4 * 4) / 64 = (q4 * 4 + 3) / 64 := by omega

/-- Gather grid covers all work items. -/
theorem gather_grid_covers (total : Nat) : total ≤ (total + 255) / 256 * 256 := by omega

/-- Dequantised value is the stored int times the scale: sign symmetric (integer shadow). -/
theorem dequant_neg (q : Int) (s : Int) : (-q) * s = -(q * s) := by
  rw [Int.neg_mul]

/-- A zero scale quantises everything to zero. -/
theorem zero_scale_zero (q s : Int) (h : s = 0) : q * s = 0 := by subst h; simp

end Strata.KvQ8
